thread:
maria-support: Customer on managed-hosted reported 404s after upgrading to @redwood/node v0.26.1 — previously working chat.reply calls now return 404: "route not found". Customer says they only changed SDK version.

jake-engr: Can you paste the snippet they're calling and the full error payload?

maria-support: From customer:
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await client.chat.reply({
  conversationId: 'conv_123',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the doc'}]
})
// error: 404 { code: 'route_not_found', route: 'chat.reply' }
```
They attached logs showing retries and lots of 404s started right after npm update.

sam-devx: Which API spec/version is that SDK targeting? Could be codegen changed route surface.

maria-support: Customer said package.json had "@redwood/node": "^0.26.1" upgraded yesterday; before was 0.24.x.

jake-engr: I can repro locally. New SDK calls /v1/chat/reply but server expects /v1/chat/respond (spec v1.2). SDK has stale route mapping.

eng-runtime-bot: Traced request id r-9f2a4d7c — 404 on routing layer, expected /v1/chat/respond handler.

sam-devx: That's a codegen/SDK bug. Short-term workaround: pin to older SDK or call REST directly.

maria-support: Workaround shared:
1) npm install @redwood/node@0.24.6
2) Or direct fetch to /v1/chat/respond with payload key `input` instead of `messages`.

riley-cs: Customer is on paid plan and asks about credits consumed by retries — they saw thousands of retry attempts due to automatic retry loop after upgrade.

jake-engr: We'll refund excess charges for the spike. Opening billing ticket after confirming telemetry counts.

sam-devx: Filed internal bug: SDK codegen mapping mismatch for v0.26.1. Patch in progress, will backport quick release 0.26.2 mapping chat.reply -> /v1/chat/respond and messages->input.

eng-runtime-bot: Patch branch fix/sdk-route-mappings-347 created. CI green, running integration tests.

maria-support: Customer pinned to 0.24.6 and confirmed 200s. They asked ETA for fix to re-upgrade.

jake-engr: ETA 0.26.2 ~4 hours once integration tests pass, we'll push release and update changelog.

sam-devx: Docs note: add migration guide for SDK v0.26+ about chat.* method renames and payload key changes. Add REDWOOD_API_LEGACY env var to force legacy routing for now.

maria-support: Marking resolved for support; will reopen if 0.26.2 doesn't fix. :thumbsup:
